title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park on 1969-07-12
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park
source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard remaster with a standout China Cat Sunflower, though St. Stephen suffers from tuning issues.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard remaster that most listeners find clear and enjoyable, earning a four‑star rating for its technical quality. Musically the show shines on China Cat Sunflower, but the performance of St. Stephen is noted as out of tune, leading to mixed feelings overall.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer praises the remaster and a key song (4★), while another gives a zero rating with vague criticism; overall show quality is moderate, recording quality good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster is solid and clear; no major mix issues reported, though performance tuning problems are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; reviewers focus on individual song quality.
